bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 300L
	n_sets = 20L
	sets = vector("list", n_sets)
	for (s in seq_len(n_sets)) {
		w = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)
		Z = matrix(rnorm(n * 3L), n, 3L)
		X = cbind(as.numeric(w), Z)
		latent = drop(X %*% c(0.6, 0.5, -0.4, 0.3)) + rlogis(n)
		y = as.numeric(cut(latent, breaks = c(-Inf, quantile(latent, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)), Inf), labels = FALSE))
		sets[[s]] = list(X = X, y = y)
	}
	sets
}
